classification.difficultyReason: Find two quartile positions, read corresponding scores from an ogive and subtract.

content.prompt:
A set of data is represented by the cumulative frequency histogram and ogive.

What is the best approximation for the interquartile range for this set of data?

spec.description: Adjoining unshaded outlined cumulative-frequency bars and a straight-segment ogive, with arrowed axes and dotted horizontal reference lines.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied data are visible; quartile readings and calculations are held in the editable answer.

answer.worked:
The total cumulative frequency is $800$.

$$\begin{aligned}Q_1\text{ position} &= \frac{800}{4}\\&=200\\Q_3\text{ position} &= \frac{3\times800}{4}\\&=600\end{aligned}$$

Reading from the ogive, a cumulative frequency of $200$ corresponds to a score of $45$, and a cumulative frequency of $600$ corresponds to a score of $80$.

$$\begin{aligned}\text{IQR} &= Q_3-Q_1\\&\approx80-45\\&=35\end{aligned}$$
